'''Otor's Hub''' was a [[Black market/Legends|black market]] [[Space station/Legends|space station]] in the [[Outer Rim Territories/Legends|Outer Rim Territories]]' [[Ojoster sector/Legends|Ojoster sector]]. Located close to a [[Planet/Legends|planet]], it was fairly large and served as a way station within the Outer Rim. During the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]], [[Jedi Master/Legends|Jedi Master]] [[Obi-Wan Kenobi/Legends|Obi-Wan Kenobi]] and [[Sith/Legends|Sith]] [[Assassin/Legends|assassin]]&ndash;turned&ndash;[[Bounty hunter/Legends|bounty hunter]] [[Asajj Ventress/Legends|Asajj Ventress]] stopped on Otor's Hub together after losing a [[Skirmish above Raydonia/Legends|confrontation]] with the Sith brothers [[Darth Maul/Legends|Darth Maul]] and [[Savage Opress/Legends|Savage Opress]] over [[Raydonia/Legends|Raydonia]].
